displayIdentity.body: Objections ask what advantage and faithfulness remain. Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision? Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
